learned_patterns.name: Verify Dataverse schema with direct EntityDefinitions lookups
learned_patterns.context: Confirming that tables exist before building a persistence layer against them
learned_patterns.pattern: Query EntityDefinitions(LogicalName='x') per table. A filtered or full collection scan is silently paginated and reports tables missing that exist; metadata entities also reject contains and startswith filters.

learned_patterns.name: Cache-only serving with an explicit miss contract
learned_patterns.context: Serving published form definitions from a render cache
learned_patterns.pattern: When a cache is authoritative, a miss returns a named domain error (404 FORM_NOT_PUBLISHED) rather than falling back to live metadata. The fallback is what hides publishing bugs until production.

common_mistakes.mistake: Assuming Dataverse option-set values are 0-based ordinals
common_mistakes.symptom: Values map to the wrong label, or writes fail validation
common_mistakes.prevention: Codes are 100000000-based. Read them from metadata and map explicitly.

common_mistakes.mistake: Using the lowercase logical attribute name for @odata.bind
common_mistakes.symptom: Navigation property not recognised on create
common_mistakes.prevention: Navigation properties are PascalCase-prefixed (Qdb_reportdefinitionid). Take the name from metadata verbatim.

common_mistakes.mistake: Passing an unvalidated caller id for impersonation
common_mistakes.symptom: Writes return 404 while reads succeed — reads as a missing table
common_mistakes.prevention: MSCRMCallerID must be a real systemuser id, or blank to run as the service application.

common_mistakes.mistake: Treating an alternate-key collision as a generic 4xx
common_mistakes.symptom: Duplicate qdb_reportcode surfaces as an unhelpful error
common_mistakes.prevention: Unique alternate keys return HTTP 412. Handle it by name; read new record ids from the OData-EntityId response header.

common_mistakes.mistake: Writing a parent and its children without a transaction
common_mistakes.symptom: A mid-way child create failure leaves orphaned parent records
common_mistakes.prevention: Use an OData $batch changeset for multi-entity writes. Open item on both the report and dashboard writers.

preferred_approaches.approach: Zod-validated environment parsing at the boundary; reference variable names in documentation, never values.
preferred_approaches.rationale: Constitution Article VII. An Azure AD secret was committed in an earlier engagement and still requires rotation (SEC-01).

preferred_approaches.approach: Sandboxed evaluators only — NCalc in .NET, the in-house ExpressionEngine in Node. Jint and DynamicExpresso were rejected on code-execution grounds.
preferred_approaches.rationale: Arbitrary code execution fails the no-code-exec control on every audit.
